signals.rule:
Every session candidate of the two sleeves for BTC / ETH / SOL at each 4h slot (as_of = slot + 5 min), kept when
(1) the session did not block it (weekend rule S4, stop inside the minimum distance, no sigma), (2) its net E[R]
after costs is > 0 (the paper gate, risk.yaml min_net_expected_r_paper), and (3) for trend_4h, it is an ONSET: the
same symbol x side had no kept trend_4h candidate at the previous slot (the tilt is a state, re-proposed every slot
while it lasts; an onset is when the paper book would first see it). shock_regime candidates are new by
construction (lookback 4 bars = one slot). Stop cap = the 4-sigma prior, edges = the documented priors (the
posteriors start 2026-11-14). Outcome-free: no price after as_of is read.

H-EXE1.t0: the order is sent at as_of (slot + 5 min); the candidate (entry = last 1h close, stop, target) uses data known at as_of only
H-EXE1.arms: market: taker order executed latency_ms after t0 against the replayed ob200 book (walks the levels); limit_N: PostOnly at the touch, re-pegged to the touch (amend, back of the new queue), cancel sent at t0 + N min, partial fills kept, unfilled = 0 R (crates/atx/src/exec_replay.rs)
H-EXE1.size: qty = 0.5% x 10,000 USDT / (|entry - stop| + entry x 15 bp) (risk engine, market-entry costs), floored to the lot step; the same qty for every arm of a signal

costs.market_entry: taker 5.5 bp + the real book's slippage (VWAP vs touch)
costs.exit: taker 5.5 + slippage 2.0 bp (fees.yaml exit leg), identical rule in every arm

H-EXE1.exit: from the last entry fill: the first print at/through the stop or target in the day's tape (exit at that print's price); later days: lake 1h bybit last-price bars, stop first when both are touched in a bar (at-exec's conservative rule), a gap through the level fills at the bar open; still open at the last bar = marked at its close (exit cost charged)
H-EXE1.R: net R = [side x filled_qty x (exit - vwap) - entry fee - exit fee] / (qty x |entry - stop|); entry = the candidate's price
H-EXE1.statistic: paired per-signal difference limit_N - market in net R, both sleeves pooled; mean with a day-clustered bootstrap (clusters = UTC days of t0, B = 10000, percentile 95% CI); pro-rata primary, other queues reported
H-EXE1.segments: llm_in_sample (t0 < 2026-07-01) and clean_holdout (t0 >= 2026-07-01) recorded separately (plus pooled)
H-EXE1.verdict: supports: for at least one N, mean > 0 with the CI above 0 (pro-rata, pooled sleeves); contradicts: for every N the CI is below 0; else inconclusive
H-EXE1.missed_winners: per N (pro-rata): share of signals unfilled / partly filled; their market-arm net R (mean, share > 0, share reaching the target); decomposition of the difference into the filled part (price + fee) and the missed part

H-MMR3.split: agent M's split (data/research/mm_replay/split.json, chronological, written before any P&L)

widths.specs: agent M's variant specs (split.json grid), BTC max_net_usd 0

gate.V: short-horizon vol in its bottom tercile: RV60(t) = sqrt(sum of squared 1m log returns over the 60 closed minutes before t) <= the 1/3 quantile of RV60 over the symbol's FIT-day minutes
gate.R: narrow 4h range: |ln(close(t) / close(t - 240 min))| < sigma_4h(t) = sqrt(48) x sigma_5m(t), sigma_5m = RMS of the 288 clock-5m log returns of the 24 h before t
gate.S: no shock in the last 6 h: no closed clock hour with |ln(close / previous hour's close)| >= 4 x sigma_1h, sigma_1h = sqrt(12) x sigma_5m as of that hour's start, closing in (t - 6 h, t] (mirrors the shock sleeve's |z| >= 4)
gate.J_field: BTCUSDT: the probability field's P(jump in the next hour) from the frozen pre-cutoff fit (data/models/field/btc_field_cutoff_2026-07-01.json; state from the 1h lake frame, row valid from its known_ts) <= its median over the FIT-day hours
gate.J_hawkes: illiquid (and BTC as a secondary): Hawkes-type jump excitation lambda(t) = sum over past jump minutes j of 2^(-(t - t_j) / 60 min), jump minute = |r_1m| > 4 x sigma_1m (RMS of the 1440 1m returns before it); <= its median over the FIT-day minutes
gate.warm: a component needs its full look-back (24 h of 1m bars, 288 5m returns, 240 min); before that the gate is off
gate.all: V and R and S and J (J = J_field for BTCUSDT, J_hawkes for TRX/ETC/XLM); a decision tick with the gate off quotes exit-only (reduce-only, the live wind-down path, no new inventory); `_flat` variants instead cancel and close at market (taker) when the gate turns off with inventory

H-MMR3.engine: atx mm-replay (live atx mm quoting code; ob200 + trade tape; queue models; 150 ms latency; fees crypto maker 2.0 / taker 5.5 bp; each symbol-day flat at 00:00, marked at 24:00; warm-up bars of the two previous days)
H-MMR3.statistic: paired per symbol-day difference gated(all, exit-only) - ungated at the primary width on HELD days, per group, pro-rata; day-clustered bootstrap (B = 10000) 95% CI; decomposition (spread, adverse 1/10/60 s, inventory, fees, fills) and single-component gates reported; secondary widths and the _flat variants reported, not part of the verdict
H-MMR3.verdict: supports: difference > 0 with the CI above 0 in at least one group; contradicts: CI below 0 in both groups; else inconclusive

data.one_at_a_time: download a symbol-day, run every replay it needs, verify, delete
